## Summary

Brief description of the change and its motivation.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional change)
- [ ] Test addition / improvement

## Related Issue

Closes #(issue number)

- Change 1
- Change 2
- Change 3

How was this tested? Include commands, configurations, and outcomes.

```bash
# e.g., validated config JSON / ran notebook end-to-end on test corpus
```

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project style
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented complex or non-obvious sections
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/`
- [ ] I have added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] Configuration JSON files validate
- [ ] **No secrets, API keys, or screening data are committed**
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
